payload.text: The Crown notes the divergent accounts. E-001 records Mira describing Fictional Morgan handing a blue token to Fictional Ellis at the desk. E-002 records Tavi stating Fictional Morgan left with the token still in hand; Tavi states no handover seen. Both are attributed, disputed accounts. Mira's account, if accepted, addresses the listed receipt condition; Tavi's, if accepted, does not. The burden beyond a reasonable doubt rests on the Crown, and disputed attribution alone does not establish receipt.

Defence agrees with the Crown: the supplied record contains only attributed accounts. E-001 records Mira describing Fictional Morgan handing a blue token to Fictional Ellis at the desk. E-002 records Tavi stating Fictional Morgan left with the token still in hand and that no handover was seen. Neither account is established proof. Attribution alone cannot satisfy the Crown's burden beyond a reasonable doubt on the listed receipt element, and no further evidence is offered.
